name: DotEnvTools
description: Installs the DotEnvTools PowerShell module and can optionally initialize starter dotenv files after container creation.

version.description: DotEnvTools module version to install from GitHub Releases.

archivePath.description: Optional local ZIP path inside the Feature folder. Used for CI or local testing before a GitHub Release exists.

initializeProject.description: Create starter dotenv files in the workspace after container creation.

template.description: Starter template used when initializeProject is true.

includeVariants.description: Create layered dotenv files when initializeProject is true.

environmentName.description: Environment suffix used for layered dotenv files.
